# Establishment log — bardo-thodol-009 (pp. 81–90), 2026-11-22

The first part of text **ga** (the wrathful-deities bardo). There is **no transcription of this print** for ga, so three readers
(strongest model; no Sonnet role ran) read the images line by line from scratch, with the other recension
(readings/witness_ga.txt, from source/raw/bowiki-other-recension.txt) open only as a guide to which words to expect. Reader A
read pp. 81–83, B pp. 84–86 and C pp. 87–90. Full tables are in readings/read_A-log.md, read_B-log.md and read_C-log.md.

## Layout
- p. 81 (n82) is the title leaf of text ga, with one framed line: ཁྲོ་བོའི་བར་དོ་འཆར་ཚུལ་བསྟན་པ་བཞུགས་སོ༔. ག is in the top margin.
- pp. 82 and 83 have **four** lines; pp. 84–89 have five. 89.1 is a short line closed by an empty framed box.
- The opening ornament (pp. 81, 82, 83, 85, 87, 89) is the horizontal swirl. Reader A wrote it ࿐, but it is the same
  shape as the kha leaf fronts (e.g. n76, p. 75), which parts 002–008 transcribed ༄༅༔ ༔. It is written ༄༅༔ ༔ here
  for consistency; the build drops it in any case.
- **End.** No sentence closes near the end of p. 89 (…ཐོས་གྲོལ་ཆེན་མོ་འདི་ནི་མ་བསྒོམ་པར runs on), so the part runs to
  90.2, …ངན་སོང་དུ་སོང་བ་མི་སྲིད་དོ༔. **Part 010 begins on 90.2 with འདི་དང…** The cite is pp. 81–90.

  and a tsheg. C left it unread. The editor reads འདིར ("here in the bardo of reality"), which fits each of the traces C

- **Tshegs at line joins and mid-line:** བར་དོ་འཆར (×2), ལ་འཕྲོད, འཛིན་མཁའ, འདི་ནི་ཁྲོ, ཐོབ་བརྒྱལ, པའི་གནད, ཡིན་ཏེ,

- **Contractions and abbreviations written out:** ལམ → ལ་མ, རྣམྶ → རྣམས, དགོྶ → དགོས, རྟག|སུ → རྟགས་སུ, རིངསྲེལ → རིང་སྲེལ.
  The last keeps the print's spelling without the བ prefix.
- **Stray tsheg inside a word at the 88.4/88.5 join:** ཟེར་ད་ང༔ → ཟེར་དང༔. C saw a blob at headline height after ད.
- **Misprints (rule 5b; the notes must name them):**
  1. 82.2 **དེ་ཡ་རིམ་པ → དེ་ལ**. ཡ was checked side by side with other ཡ and ལ; only "to them" makes sense. Moderate certainty.
  2. 84.2 **བརྒྱལ་བབཁོར → བརྒྱལ་བ་ཁོར**. The བ is set twice. Moderate certainty.
  3. 88.4 **ནམ་མཁར་ལ → ནམ་མཁའ་ལ**. The letter is clearly the open ར, compared with the closed འ of མཁའ earlier in the same line. Moderate to high certainty.

  needs a gi-gu as well, so it is doubtful and stays as printed.
- 87.1 ཤི་རམ, probably the print's spelling of ཤ་རི་རམ.
- 85.1 གཡང་ལ (no ས); 86.2 རིང་སྲེལ; 85.4 སྒོམས; 88.2 སོགས་པ (no ས); 86.3 ཤོང་དང (the tsheg is fused); 82.4 ཡུན་རིང ༔.

## Where the other recension differs in sense (the print is followed)
- 83.1–2: ངོ་སྤྲད་ཀྱང་མ་གྲོལ ("even though pointed out"), where the other recension has ཅིང.
- 83.3: བསུ་བ་འདས, where the other recension has བསུན་མ་འདས.
- 83.4: གནས་བསྒྱུར་དེ, where the other recension has གནས་འགྱུར་ནས. The print also has འོང་བས་གོང་དང་མི་འདྲ་སྟེ༔ འདི་ནི…, where the other recension has འོང་ངོ༔ ད་ནི…འདིར.
- 84.2: གྲོལ་བར་སླ, without ཡང.
- 85.3: ཡིན་པར་ངོ་ཤེས༔ ཡིད་ཆེས་ཏེ.
- 86.1: the print has སྟོན་པའི་ཆོས་སྤྱོད.
- 86.5: the print has དེའི་ཕྱིར "therefore", where the other recension has དེས.
- 89.3: ཐོས་གྲོལ་འདི་ཀློག, without ཆེན་མོ; ཀློག "read" stands for ཀླག.
- 89.4–5: the print adds a second group of people, "others", who are born in the higher realms.
- 90.1: སྡིག་པོ་ཆེ་གསང་ལམ་ལ་འཁྲིད, "leads great sinners onto the secret path", where the other recension has གསེབ་ལམ.
- Smaller differences of particles and ༔ are listed in the reader logs.
